title: Separability transfers to the generic residue field
statement: Let k, S, L satisfy the hypotheses of Algebra.smoothAtPrime_bot_of_isSeparable_fractionRing: k is a field, S is a commutative domain, L is a field, the displayed k-, S-, and k-algebra structures form a scalar tower, S is of finite type over k, and L is a fraction field of S. If IsSeparableExtension k L, then IsSeparableExtension k (⊥ : Ideal S).ResidueField.

proof.text: Unfold IsSeparableExtension. For each finitely generated intermediate field F of the zero-prime residue field, apply the finitely generated subextension transport theorem, which identifies F with its corresponding subfield of the fraction field and transports separable generation across the canonical residue-field/fraction-field isomorphism.
